info.name: Northstar Bank - Account Origination API
info.description: Northstar Bank’s Account Origination API enables trusted digital channels and approved fintech partners to submit, track, and manage new retail account applications for checking and savings products. The primary consumers are Northstar’s web and mobile teams, branch-assist tools, and external onboarding partners using a Postman Partner Workspace. The API centralizes application intake, decision status, applicant information, and disclosure consent so the bank can provide a consistent, governed origination experience across channels. It belongs in the API portfolio as the reusable onboarding entry point for retail deposit growth and partner-led acquisition.

item.name: 📁 E2E Workflow
POST /applications — should create a new application and return 201
GET /applications/:id — should retrieve the created application
PATCH /applications/:id/status — should move application to in_review
PATCH /applications/:id/status — should approve the reviewed application
GET /applications/:id — should verify approved state
📁 Smoke Tests
GET /health — should return healthy service status
GET /applications — should return demo seed applications
GET /health — should reject invalid API key with 401
📁 CRUD Operations
GET /applications — should list submitted applications with filters
POST /applications — should create a CRUD test application
GET /applications/:id — should retrieve CRUD test application
PATCH /applications/:id/status — should update CRUD test application
DELETE /applications/:id — should cancel CRUD test application
📁 Negative Tests
GET /applications — should return 401 for invalid API key
POST /applications — should return 400 for missing required fields
GET /applications/:id — should return 404 for unknown ID
PATCH /applications/:id/status — should return 409 for invalid transition
